assessments.final_value: nasin ni la kipisi sitelen tu li lon ma sama. o kepeken poka pini ante. nasin ante la o weka e sitelen pi awen wan tan ma pali lon tenpo open.
assessments.backtranslation: In this arrangement, portions of two images occupy the same area. Use another edge. Alternatively, first remove the connected images from the workspace.
assessments.rationale: Agree after independent author reassessment. kipisi sitelen tu makes the overlapping objects image portions rather than asserting equality of entire image bounds; in this arrangement context it expresses partial intersection as well as complete overlap. nasin ante la explicitly makes unplacing an alternative to another edge, not a subsequent mandatory operation. tan ma pali retains removal from placement rather than deletion of source or removal from the input tray. lon tenpo open applies first to unplacing in that alternative. The message is scoped to nasin ni, matching snapped/new attachment validation and not prohibiting allowed absolute-position overlap. No source/consumer semantic boundary or formatting changed.
assessments.provenance: Reviewer-authored original clarification independently assessed by original author; no third-party sentence copied.

assessments.final_value: Xpaq chaymanta Ypaq 0manta 2147483647kama junt\'a yupaykunata qillqay.
assessments.backtranslation: For X and Y, enter whole numbers from 0 to 2147483647.
assessments.rationale: The revision better describes a property of the number rather than its written notation. Bolivian junt'a has the complete/whole sense; as the attributive modifier of yupaykunata in this bounded numeric instruction it expresses integral numbers. This is a compositional judgment, not acceptance merely because junt'a pixelkunata exists in the catalogue. Xpaq and Ypaq mark the two coordinate fields; chaymanta joins them; -manta and -kama delimit the inclusive interval; plural accusative yupaykunata is the object of imperative qillqay. Both endpoints, including zero, remain explicit. placementPixels tests parsed finite numeric value against floor and the 0..Int.MAX_VALUE bounds, rather than banning a decimal separator: integral values represented as 0.0 are not excluded by this wording. No arbitrary fractional rounding, positive-only restriction or automatic placement success is promised.
